decision.structure: Collection family classification supplies the canonical receiver/result storage to ownership consumers without discarding the nominal heap, deque or set identity. CSharp registers BinaryHeap and Deque identities in its dynamic-array table and Set in its Unit-valued dictionary table. SLG canonical collection-family predicates retain nominal builtin identity while exposing the same storage and intrinsic result families.
decision.branches: Dynamic-array kind3 and canonical Deque/Heap applications share admitted length/capacity/reserve results; dictionaries, bounded dictionaries and canonical Set retain their dictionary family. Heap-allocated storage excludes bounded dictionary kind13. Existing numeric receiver restrictions remain.
decision.logic: Materialize the canonical receiver type before intrinsic result lookup. Ordinary and entry IR lowering use the same isHeapCollection predicate for reserve; member types and native handle identity do not come from operation spelling.
decision.diagnostics: The existing named provider and original diagnostics remain authoritative. Exact current complete-file review hashes are checked for this source dependency link. No historical run is promoted to a new current-Native acceptance.
